build_YOLOF_detector: build a YOLOF single-stage object detector with backbone, neck, and bbox_head config
run_YOLOF_loss: run the YOLOF detector loss computation on a batch of input images and data samples
run_YOLOF_predict: run the YOLOF detector to predict bounding boxes and class labels on input images
run_YOLOF_extract_feat: run the YOLOF detector feature extraction through backbone and neck on input images
review_YOLOF_init: review the YOLOF detector initialization with backbone, neck, bbox_head, train_cfg, and test_cfg
